acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

A data-dependent acquisition method in the Xcalibur software (Thermo Fisher Scientific) was set up, optimizing the number of precursors selected (“top speed”) of charge 2+ to 5+ from each survey scan, while maintaining a fixed scan cycle of 1s per FAIMS CV.

fractionation_method.evidence: In brief, samples were fractionated in 6 fractions using the Pierce High pH Reversed-Phase Peptide Fractionation Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
